intro: One glass of mamak teh tarik has about 120 kcal (estimate). Most calories come from the condensed milk, not the tea itself.
diet: Yes, teh tarik can still fit into a weight loss plan. One glass a day is no big deal if your daily calories are under control. What people often miss is that 2-3 glasses a day can add 300+ kcal without making you full. So control how often, no need to ban it completely.
tips: Order 'teh tarik kurang manis' and save about 40 kcal straight away.
Pick a small glass or hot cup, not the big iced glass.
If you already had teh tarik in the morning, go for plain water or teh O kosong for your next drink.

swap.name: Teh C kosong (evaporated milk, no sugar)
swap.why: Still has that creamy milk taste, but no sugar and no condensed milk.

faq.q: What's the difference between teh tarik and regular milk tea?
faq.a: Teh tarik is 'pulled' from one jug to another until it's frothy. The base is the same: strong tea and condensed milk.

faq.q: Does teh tarik have a lot of caffeine?
faq.a: Yes, about the same or a bit less than a cup of coffee. If you're sensitive to caffeine, avoid it late in the afternoon.

faq.q: Can I ask for teh tarik with evaporated milk only?
faq.a: Yes, most mamak understand if you ask for 'teh C'. Less sweet but still creamy.
